implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory evaluation using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted gpt-5-mini API. For each of K=200 deterministically selected tasks (SHA-256 sorted), issue one shared initial generation call per task; validator runs deterministically; when validation fails, issue at most one automated guarded repair call per task. All scoring and exclusion decisions are automated and deterministic; no human labour. CPU-only analysis and artifact processing; model calls via hosted API. Log per-call headers, prompts, responses, and SHA-256 hashes for contamination detection. Abort only on unrecoverable provider/infrastructure failure as preregistered.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic assembly from public change-intent pool referenced in public_resources. Filter by preregistered verifier coverage matrix. Compute SHA-256(intent_string) for each candidate, sort ascending, select first K=200. Log all excluded intents with automated exclusion reason. No human selection.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single-generation candidate per task). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (shared initial candidate; deterministic validator; at most one automated repair generation if validator fails). All transformations executed under the adapter's deterministic harness and semantic-equivalence checks preregistered.
randomisation_plan: Paired within-task design: no random assignment of conditions. Task selection deterministic (SHA-256 sort). Batch ordering fixed as listed; tie-breaking deterministic using seed=42.
caching_plan: Cache all prompts, model responses, and computed SHA-256 hashes to local durable storage. On retried calls reuse cached successful responses. Cached entries are authoritative for reproducibility and logged in the artifact manifest.
failure_recovery_plan: On transient API/infrastructure error, perform single automatic retry (per-call). If retry fails or adapter reports stateful signature persisting, flag task and follow preregistered exclusion rules (log reason). If provider outage prevents completion before maximum_model_calls limit or causes unrecoverable failure, abort run and record full execution manifest. No human adjudication or manual fixes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-task record keyed by task_index containing: intent_hash (SHA-256), baseline and guarded arms each with fields {generated_configuration_text, generation_hash, deterministic_validation_passed (bool), apply_attempted (bool), post_apply_regression (bool), model_calls_used (int), time_to_deploy_seconds (float)}, pair_inclusion_flag (included_in_primary_analysis: bool), exclusion_reason (string|null). Aggregates file contains final paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline and bootstrap CI outputs from paired_binary_analysis_v1.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls: 280 (assumes ~40% of tasks require a single guarded repair). Worst-case model calls = 400 (exactly 2 calls/task). Average hosted-call latency expected << 1 minute; wall-clock for model calls estimated < 1 hour; end-to-end CPU processing and verification expected to complete within the manifest's 7-day limit. All inference via hosted openai_responses gpt-5-mini API; token usage estimated conservatively at ≤ 500k tokens for estimated run (responses+prompts), within hosted quota constraints.
